decisions.question: DDD Project is unreachable (domain for sale); how should it be handled?
decisions.effect: Drop comp.dddproject from the package; run a supplemental workflow to add live competitors. A one-line decision rationale records the exclusion.

decisions.question: How far should screenshot evidence collection go?
decisions.effect: Real browser captures (Playwright) of key public competitor pages are taken, hashed, stored under the run directory, and attached as screenshot-proof evidence cards (captureMethod browser_capture). Generated images remain forbidden.

decisions.question: How many competitors per research run?
decisions.effect: Workflow scope stage now targets exactly 3 live competitors per run; current run is topped up to 3 via the supplemental workflow.

decisions.question: Allow partial approval when some cards are rejected?
decisions.answer: custom: free-text feedback loop instead of partial approval
decisions.answerVerbatimKo: 리서치 결과에 대한 피드백을 남겨서 전달할 수 있어야해. html 통해 만들어서 보여주고, 그 결과에 대한 평가를 사람이 그 페이지 input text에다 피드백을 남길 수 있도록 하고, 피드백 저장버튼을 만들어서 json으로 저장시킨 다음, 너가 그걸 인식해서 피드백을 수용할 수 있는 구조로
decisions.effect: Review HTML gains per-card and overall free-text feedback inputs plus a '피드백 저장' button that persists feedback JSON under runs/<id>/feedback/; Claude reads that JSON and applies the feedback in the next repair round. Batch approval stays whole-package (single-hash binding).
